input.summary:
P5 kitchen and living (parts/room-43.mjs) is built: a stove run (lit furnace and smoker) on the west wall, a spruce fence table with one stair chair south of the lane, a carpet, a barrel with a candle, and two hanging lanterns.
The z19 row stays clear from the passage (x90) to the hearth front (x88) and the stove working cell (x85). make.sh runs whole, with 10 cells placed and no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines.
Not verified: the walk check, since the shell, floor and upper-floor layers are not built in this copy, so the room tool reports no way in and the floating warnings are those missing layers.
left: Walk verdict not confirmed: with no shell in this copy, `mcd room` reports 0 of 4 floor cells reachable. Re-run `mcd room --only "P5 kitchen and living"` after the shell, stair and fittings parts merge; the lane is z19 x85..91 from passage (90,2,18) to hearth front (88,2,19) and back door front (88,2,20).

Floating warnings (carpet at 89,2,20; lanterns at 84,4,19 and 90,4,20; table and chair at y2-3) come from the missing floor layer y1 and upper floor layer y5; they should clear after the shell merges.
Light at feet is 11+ (min 11, no dark cell) but counts only 4 floor cells, since the room tool sees only the furniture cells without a floor. Re-measure after merge.
Single chair only: a second chair would block the z19 lane, so the table seats one. The cauldron and a flower pot were dropped to keep the stove working cell at x85 clear.
The hearth front (88,2,19) and back door front (88,2,20) are kept clear by design but not yet walk-tested.

waste.what: Worked out the lane and stove-front clearance cell by cell by hand, then rebuilt once after finding the stove had no reachable working cell
waste.tool: `mcd room --only` should accept a candidate layout and report unreachable furniture-enclosed cells before the write; the room check should also work on a stub shell (floor layer and passage cells at their planned coordinates) so the walk is testable before the shell merges

waste.what: Lantern and carpet floating warnings are only from the missing shell, and I could not tell them apart from real faults without reading the structure report
